visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair wearing a black 'Chiikawa' branded hoodie sits on a grey sofa. She is surrounded by numerous small Chiikawa character plushies. She smiles and gestures towards the camera. The setting is a brightly lit indoor room with shelves of collectibles visible in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a top-down view of a large cardboard box filled with yellow and blue retail boxes. The woman stands behind the box with her arms wide, expressing excitement. (3) She presents stationery items including a spiral-bound notebook with characters in chef outfits, letter sets, and folders. Her hands point to specific character details on the covers. (4) The woman displays small rubber coasters and keychains in their plastic packaging. She holds a circular red and yellow coaster with a white character close to the lens. (5) She shows a boxed milk-bottle shaped glass and mimics a drinking motion while holding it. (6) Three larger plastic figures of characters holding ramen-related items (seasoning, fork, pepper) are placed on a wooden table. She unboxes each one. (7) A specialized ramen timer device is shown with a cup of instant ramen placed on its red base. (8) She presents a soft, plush tissue box cover shaped like a ramen stand with character heads. (9) A close-up shot of her face as she speaks to someone off-camera, followed by a comedic ending where a hand reaches into the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a dialogue; a male voice questions the quantity of items, and a female host responds with high-pitched energy. An upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop track begins in the background with a prominent kick drum. (2) As the unboxing starts, loud plastic rustling and paper sliding sounds are audible. The female host's voice is rapid and cheerful, emphasizing the product names. (3) Soft digital 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects play synchronously with the appearance of colorful text on screen. (4) A distinctive 'slurp' and 'pop' sound effect occurs when the milk bottle is shown, followed by the host making a playful vocalization. (5) Mechanical plastic clicks are heard as she handles the character figurines on a hard surface. The BGM remains steady and high-arousal. (6) The video ends with a comedic shout from the female host as a sudden hand-movement sound effect plays.
